tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides consistent, calibrated feature importance across instances and identifies which features drive misclassification in a game-theoretic way. LIME and Integrated Gradients offer local interpretability to validate feature influence in specific cases. Sensitivity analysis further confirms whether setting a feature to zero alters the prediction, revealing spurious dependencies. Together, they ensure that shared features are not just correlated but actually drive predictions, even when semantically irrelevant.
